lines: A tall man appeared from out of the shadow of the pillar that the kunai had struck.
My apologies. I didn't mean to hide.
Shishigami said quietly and got into a fighting stance.
The man showed no signs of hostility and was smiling peacefully.
But Shishigami didn't seem to have the slightest intention of letting her guard down.
Yes, I knew this man's face very well.
It's youーGaku Shonosuke. What a surprise to meet you here.
It has been a while, Kotaro-sama. Really, it is quite unexpected.
Yeah... He's a high-level underboss of the Nisha Clan you've heard so much about lately.
He was on the same level as their other skilled Taimanin, such as the spear-wielding Dobashi Gonza or "Mermaid's Sapphire Eyes" Yao Bikuni.
He was a dual-wielding swordsman who specialized in Iaijutsu and used the same Falcon Jutsu as Headmistress Asagiー
He was known for using his Falcon Jutsu, with specialized movement of both arms, to draw his two swords with unbelievable speed.
Yes, you're right. I'm a servant of the Nisha Clan who has now, regrettably, become your enemy.
Because of that, it was a little difficult for me to show my face in front of you, Kotaro-samaー
Are you trying to say that's the reason why you were hiding...?
In the end... yes, that's how it goes, hm.
With no sign of remorse, Shonosuke nodded.
I had no idea my presence would be noticed.
That masked girl seems to have wonderful "eyes" and "ears."
Shishigami still remained wary of Shonosuke.
After all, the adversary was a Taimanin and underboss of Nisha, who had started the rebellion.
Of course, I didn't let my guard down either and asked Shonosuke in a firm voice.
Was this trap aimed at me, Shonosuke?
That stupid Gaiza surely knows that I came back to life, right?
And, having not learned his lesson, he sent you here. Is that the purpose of this trap?
No, it's not like that at all.
Well, I guess there's no way you'd answer honestly. If you came to kill me, that is.
Hehe, we're in a bind, huh...
Shonosuke shrugged with a bitter smile.
I am not an assassin. The fact that you or that girl would come to this store was entirely unforeseen to meー
Whether you believe me or not is all up to you.
I had come to this store because of the errand for Kiryu-senseiーwhich meant that it was a complete coincidence.
In the unlikely event that Kiryu-sensei had been in contact with Shonosuke then it might have been possible to set a trap for me.
However, it was hard to imagine that that troublemaker-and-a-half would cooperate with anyone other than Murasaki-sensei...
Well, I guess I'll believe you.
Glad to hear that. An unnecessary conflict has been avoided.
Looking at Shonosuke, who was grinning in amusement, Shishigami whispered in a hushed voice.
(Is it really okay to believe someone from the Nisha Clan, Fuma?)
(I don't completely trust him. It's simply "for the time being.")
(Yeah. As long as Shonosuke doesn't make any strange moves, we'll wait and see.)
Besides, we currently had more pressing matters at hand.
So, Shonosuke, you had nothing to do with this trap, right?
I turned back toward Shonosuke and asked him.
Regardless of what Shonosuke's true intentions were, if we didn't get out of here it wasn't worth discussing.
No... To be exact, I can't say I had "nothing" to do with it.
This trap was intended for me. Which means, the two of you just happened to get caught in it... I guess that would be the whole truth to it.
This was a baffling explanation. But just when I was about to ask for more detailsー
When I looked up due to Shishigami's piercing voice, things resembling black vortices were forming all over the store.
Countless Will-o'-wisps were trying to crawl out from them.
Hey, hey. Are those things still appearing...?
It really seems to be that kind of trap.
No matter how strong one is, their skills will falter if fatigue builds up. That is what this trap is aiming for. It is quite clever.
This is not the time to be impressed!! We'll talk about this later!! Find the monster that's controlling them, both of you!!
So for now we are on the same side. ーUnderstood.
